notes: Snapshot clocks differ by up to a minute between screens of one session (15:11 to 15:16 UTC in showcase-desk).
Each stylized-systems tile has a different unit selected: the app picked it as each system was isolated.
Unit tags inside the stylized-systems tiles are about 8 px at 1x; the system glows carry the banner.
focus-sbo repeats the pending-command bar in a loupe by design.
